release.reason: The protected Vercel Preview has not yet been reached by the automated HTTP smoke because the GitHub Actions VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET is not configured.
release.claimAllowed: Build and Preview deployment readiness may be described; production/runtime SEO success may not be claimed.

googleSearch.interpretation: This is a Google Search Performance baseline only. It does not mean zero indexed URLs or zero Google awareness.

searchAI.interpretation: The prompt set is frozen, but no Search AI visibility result may be claimed before the first protocol-compliant collection.

earnedAuthority.interpretation: Distribution assets are prepared, but no earned result is claimed before independent third-party evidence exists.

commercialAttribution.interpretation: Attribution infrastructure is prepared; no lead, meeting or revenue result is claimed until a delivered real event exists.

timeToSignal.interpretation: No elapsed-time claim can begin until the relevant start event has actually occurred.

integrityRules: PRE is implementation readiness, not evidence of effect.
M1 is a first signal and cannot be converted into a promise of repeatability.
Negative and inconclusive outcomes remain in the historical record.
A time range may be proposed only after multiple comparable observations with sufficient maturity.
Search AI mention, citation, provider recommendation and lead attribution are measured separately.
A prospect declaration of discovery supports attribution but does not prove algorithmic causality.
nextStateChangeRequires: Production HTTP/SEO smoke reaches the application and passes.
The new architecture is released to production.
The first protocol-compliant Search AI baseline is collected.
Post-launch distribution actually starts before earned-authority timing begins.
Real Search, referral or commercial observations are recorded before any PRE item advances to M1.
immutabilityNote: This file is a dated snapshot. Future state changes must be published as a new dated snapshot rather than silently rewriting this historical record.
